claims: entry-point retrieval and TreeRouter routing only; no context quality, no agent success; a fixture regression floor, not generalization
gold_mapping: file#A.b -> SymbolId(file, [(A,0),(b,0)]); missing/ambiguous excluded and listed per task

metric_definitions.coverage_at_routed_size: diagnostic: gold in plain lexical top-N, N = routed universe size
metric_definitions.deferral_loss: gold reached but not explored because a bound fired
metric_definitions.entry_coverage: mapped gold anywhere in the CandidateSet
metric_definitions.mrr: 1 / CandidateSet position of the first gold, 0 if none
metric_definitions.pruning_loss: gold reached but pruned by a branch judgment
metric_definitions.recall@k: mapped gold in the first k CandidateSet entries / mapped gold, macro over tasks
metric_definitions.region_coverage: the file region of mapped gold among routed candidates

retrieval_configs.config: RetrievalConfig { lexical: true, structural: false, lexical_limit: 20, symbol_limit: 8 }
retrieval_configs.label: lexical-only

retrieval_configs.config: RetrievalConfig { lexical: false, structural: true, lexical_limit: 20, symbol_limit: 8 }
retrieval_configs.label: structural-only

retrieval_configs.config: RetrievalConfig { lexical: true, structural: true, lexical_limit: 20, symbol_limit: 8 }
retrieval_configs.label: lexical+structural

route_limits: RouteLimits { max_regions: 64, max_depth: 2, max_fanout: 16, max_edges: 2048, max_judgments: 64 }
route_policy: RoutePolicy { follow: [Calls, References, Imports, Implements, TestedBy, Contains(Logical)], ascend: true, prune_below: 0.25 }
